subject.title: feat: publish integrations and Crabbox Agent Skill discovery

question: Should Crabbox adopt the full draft domain-discovery and cross-vendor catalog publication surface in core, or should this PR be narrowed to the canonical Skill and backward-compatible local discovery path?
rationale: The branch adds a long-lived public integration/distribution contract beyond a narrow bug fix, and no maintainer decision is visible in the supplied discussion.

options.title: Land a narrowed, compatible Skill path
options.body: Keep the canonical Skill and repeatable local generation after preserving legacy `--skill` destinations, while deferring draft domain/catalog publication and broad ecosystem claims to a separately sponsored proposal.

options.title: Sponsor the full discovery contract
options.body: Accept the static Agent Skills and AI Catalog/ARD publication surface, then require explicit compatibility and deployment proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Land a narrowed, compatible Skill path
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical Skill and repeatable local generation after preserving legacy `--skill` destinations, while deferring draft domain/catalog publication and broad ecosystem claims to a separately sponsored proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: They have prior merged work in the directly affected Zed/integration area and authored the current implementation proposal.
